inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Several of the documented fire drills exceed the three-minute maximum evacuation time.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when a fire drill was conducted and completed in two minutes and eight seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One of the six children's files reviewed did not have a complete admission packet. The following information was missing: an address for the listed emergency contact , a physician-signed health statement (child was enrolled 8/1/25), and an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Two caregivers were observed utilizing their cell phones while their classes were on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline by striking a child's hand as redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the walkthrough, a caregiver stated there were nineteen children in care when there were twenty.    Note: this was corrected when the children were recounted
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: At the time of inspection, one out of the six children's files did not have a Physician's Health Statement for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During the walkthrough, an infant was observed sleeping with a bib on.     Note: The bib was removed immediately
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The permit holder failed to notify CCR that a written notice from a governmental entity indicating that the holder's corporate privileges are forfeited and/or in danger of forfeiture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Two children do not have a physician's health statement signed by a doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children: At the time of the inspection, a caregiver was observed using a cell phone to print labels. Another caregiver was sending text messages about children's arrivals throughout the morning, instead of signing children in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the walkthrough, multiple children were observed climbing on tables, bookshelves, blocks, and playing in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One out of the six children's files reviewed did not have complete information for authorized pick up persons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One out of six children did not have the health care information listed in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Three out of the six children's files reviewed did not have a statement of health from a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was supervising 23 children. The specified age for the group was three years old meaning the caregiver could only have 15 at one time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: During the inspection, multiple children were observed drinking out of cups and eating foods while walking around.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: At the time of the inspection the previous year's training records were not available for five of the six staff files reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: At the time of the inspection, two out of the six staff files reviewed did not have pre-service training for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection, there were multiple plugs missing covers in the classrooms.     NOTE: this was corrected at inspection when outlet covers were placed on the plugs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Six out of the six staff member files showed that they had only the online portion of the CPR certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The center's director left the operation to run errands, leaving a caregiver alone with 23 children, including an infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: During the inspection, the sheets on the infant cribs were too small for the mattresses, causing the mattresses to fold over on themselves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of the six children's files reviewed did not have complete emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: At the time of inspection, two out of the six children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Caregiver had 23 children in care, ranging from 17 months to 10 years of age. The difference in age between the youngest and oldest was greater than 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of the caregivers did not have first aid training at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Caregivers had 18 children in care, the youngest being 16 months old and the oldest child in the group is an 8 year old, therefore the youngest/oldest children present are more than 18 months apart.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: At the time of the inspection, one child did not have immunization records for review. This is recited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: During the inspection, an infant caregiver did not have training in the required infant safety topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: During the walkthrough, there were multiple children sleeping with their milk cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: At the time of the inspection, two children did not have immunization records for review and one child's records were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During the inspection, the staff did not have Building Safety training for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Recite;  Caregiver in the duckie classroom had 17 children in care.  Based on the specified age group caregiver can only have 15 children in her group.    Caregiver in the lambs room walked out of the infant room, leaving caregiver out of ratio with 7 infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: One classroom did not have a smoke detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Director did not have an admission form for one child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: RECITE;    Caregiver had 17 children in care, and one child is 15 month old and the oldest child in the group is an 8 year old, therefore the youngest/oldest children present are more than 18 months apart.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: During inspection it was observed that an infant was walking around drinking his bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During inspection caregiver stated that she had 15 children in care, and after counting it was determined caregiver had 16 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The lambs classroom was observed out of ratio, caregiver had 5 children ages 3 month, 5 month, 8 month, 8 month and 12 month.  Based on the specified age group caregiver can only have 4 infants in her group.     Caregiver in the duckie classroom had 19 children in care.  Based on the specified age group caregiver can only have 11 children in her group.    Note:  Two caregiver's arrived to assist with ratios.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: The infant cribs were not labeled with child's name.    Note:  Corrected at inspection when caregiver labeled the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Caregiver had 19 children in care, and two children were 10/11 month old and the oldest child in the group is an 8 year old, therefore the youngest/oldest children present are more than 18 months apart.     Note:  Corrected when caregiver who came in at 9:45 am, took the two infants to lambs classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four infants did not have updated infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation did not report the number of employees that ceased working in the previous year 2024 by the required date of January 15, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: All six staff files reviewed during inspection did not have CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out the ten children's records reviewed did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two out of the six files reviewed during inspection did not have orientation completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The most recent health inspection was not available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: All six staff files reviewed during inspection did not have current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: One out of the ten children's records reviewed during inspection did not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Dust can be seen accumilated by an air vent. Empty spider webs were observed in a playground structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A blanket was observed in the crib with a 2 month old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of the two children's records reviewed during inspection did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Wooden boards observed broken in the playscape, The slide on the same play structure was observed cracked resulting in a gap. Nails were observed protruding from the playscape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Garbage was observed accessible to the children in care as a trash can in the children's restroom was not covered.     Note: This was corrected at inspection as the trashcan was covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children observed did not wash their hands before breakfast.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when other children were directed to wash hands before eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Good judgement was not exersiced when a two year old child was strapped to a high chair placed on an inadequate small chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed sitting in a baby walker.    Note:  This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION when the walker was removed from the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Thick layers of dust built up were observed on vents through out the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed caring for children without an eligible background check. A 16 year old was observed at the operation without an eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A blanket was observed in the crib with a 10 month old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: Infant's individual storage space must be labeled either with the child's name, photo or symbol.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: HRC42.054 - Required Fees: The operation had an outstanding balance of $4 for their background checks and it was paid during insepction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.054 - Required Fees (26 TAC §HRC42.054 - Required Fees)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms were not observed in the vehicle for four of the children being transported by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 Years and More Than 40 Pounds; 5 - 7 Years and Under 4 Feet, 9 Inches: Two five years old were observed transported by the operation staff without a booster seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 Years and More Than 40 Pounds; 5 - 7 Years and Under 4 Feet, 9 Inches (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The parent contact authorization forms were not observed in the vehicle for four of the children being transported by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System -  12 Months Through 3 Years; More Than 20 Pounds: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a three year old was transported without the proper front facing child safety seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System -  12 Months Through 3 Years; More Than 20 Pounds (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A cord to the ac mounted in the window located in the three to five year old classroom was observed accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A hole in the ceiling and mold were observed in a closet located in the three to five year old classroom.    Blinds in the three to five year old classroom were observed dirty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
